activity.role: Commander of the reconstituted Sich Riflemen detachment in the Ukrainian State; subsequently joined the anti-Hetman uprising
activity.role_display_name_ko: 우크라이나국 시기 재편된 시치 소총병 지휘관·반헤트만 봉기 참여자
activity.notes: On 23 August 1918 Hetman Skoropadskyi authorized Konovalets to form a separate Sich Riflemen detachment at Bila Tserkva. This period locates his military organization within the then-controlling Ukrainian State; the 'active_in' relation does NOT claim he was the Hetman's loyal political officer. In November 1918 he supported the Directory's insurrection against the Hetman and moved into the restored UNR phase.

sources.title: Konovalets, Yevhen — Encyclopedia of Ukraine
sources.citation_text: Confirms death on 23 May 1938, two Sich Riflemen command phases across the Hetmanate rupture, UVO underground leadership, and founding OUN chairmanship in 1929.

sources.title: I. Ya. Khoma (2012), Military and Political Activities of Yevhen Konovalets (November 1917–November 1918)
sources.citation_text: Military scholarly bibliography explicitly covers changing state and military command contexts from November 1917 to November 1918.

sources.title: Sich Riflemen — Encyclopedia of Ukraine
sources.citation_text: Records KSS refusal to recognize Hetmanate and April 1918 disarmament; renewed formation and 1918–1919 Ukrainian People's Republic military command.

sources.title: Коновалець Євген — Ukrainian Institute of National Memory, UNR 1917–1921
sources.citation_text: Official Ukrainian history record dates his Galician-Bukovinian Sich Riflemen command from early December 1917, regiment command from 17 March 1918, Siege Corps from 21 November 1918, eastern-front command January 1919 and renewed corps command February 1919.
